definition: Unchanged (E226's predictions.json 'definition'); N is a reading on E226's K* and s, not a clause of the definition, and no verdict on the definition is given. Per variable u: w_u = M's mechanism matrix, w_u + dw_u = F's (commute.kstar_vpd: a subcomponent's w_u = u_c v_c^T, dw_u = du_c v_c^T + u_c dv_c^T from the least-squares split; a site remainder's w_u = Delta, dw_u = delta-W_out); ratio_u = |dw_u|^2 / |w_u|^2 (Frobenius); t_u = (1 - s_u) / ratio_u, s_u at the read positions (E226's main grade), recomputed in fp64; N = 1 - mean t_u over the changed K* members with a ratio (|w_u| > 0 and ratio_u >= ratio_min), N_w = 1 - sum |a_u| t_u / sum |a_u|, a_u E226's ranking-0 attribution. K* = E226's polished set of each search (main: all of D; half1, half2 for the six known items). Side ratio: ratio_in_u = sum over settings of |dw_u y|^2 / sum of |w_u y|^2, settings as for s_u (M's and F's runs, read positions), giving N_in.

settings.settings_source: row 1: E226's main grade, the read positions (its predictions.json main_grade); ranking 0: the attribution E238 (experiments/r_reanalysis/run.py, readings) weights Rw_K with, at c = 1/2, the one ranking every item has; control_size 0.1 and control_site 0 (the first site in sorted order): a construction check only, any small size and any site with non-zero subcomponents give the same exact identity

thresholds.thresholds_source: ratio_min: 1 - s_u is computed in fp64 as 1 - cos^2 with cos^2 near 1, so its absolute error is ~1e-16 (fp64 unit roundoff); a part with ratio_u under 1e-12 would carry an error in t_u of 1e-4 or more, and a known item's split puts a tiny change on every subcomponent of its site (n_changed 3,585 for x10, experiments/kstar_vpd/results/items/x10.json), so such parts are left out of N and counted (n_small) rather than let rounding set t; split_fp64_tol, F_from_pieces_tol, M_from_pieces_tol: E226's filed values (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/predictions.json), the same split; control_tol: the construction identities hold to fp64 rounding (~1e-15) once the pieces are fp32 (|du|^2 / |u|^2 and u . du then off by ~1e-7 relative), so 1e-5 relative catches a formula error (order 1) and not rounding; R_repro_tol: R recomputed on E226's saved K* with the fp64 s against R from E226's saved fp32 s, a guard that the item rebuilt is the one E226 read: the smallest R difference between two known items is 3e-4 (x2 0.99921, moved 0.99889, experiments/r_reanalysis/results/summary.json .known.R.values), and 1e-5 is 30x under it; a GPU other than E226's H100 changes the fp32 forwards by reduction order only (~1e-7 relative), and the first item logs its deviation
